title: 卵巢癌相关临床研究登记库（2026）
date_scope: 仅纳入登记/首次公示日期为2026-01-01至2026-10-17（含）的记录；既往登记年份排除。
disease_scope: 卵巢恶性肿瘤；纳入适用范围内的输卵管癌/原发性腹膜癌。排除PCOS和良性/非肿瘤卵巢疾病。
data_boundary: 研究登记快照，不是治疗指南、疗效证据等级、入组资格判断或个体治疗建议。注册状态、研究状态、地区许可和中心开放状态不可互换。 Raw source_record details containing trial staff names/contact fields are deliberately excluded from the distributable snapshot; the official source URL remains available for verification.
source_coverage: ClinicalTrials.gov query set is complete for its stated query; ChinaDrugTrials and ChiCTR are partial subsets. See source_coverage table and README.
privacy: No investigator/contact personal names, phone numbers, email addresses or direct addresses are stored.
